gloss_en: Fasting (ta'anit) — the religious-ascetic practice of abstaining from eating and drinking as a devotional act, which weakens the body's four elements, subdues the liver/anger before the brain, breaks the craving for food, elicits peace and joy, and rectifies speech; equated with tzedakah ('the reward of the fast is charity') and likened to the World to Come, in which there is no eating or drinking. Not the Talmudic tractate Ta'anit, and not affliction/suffering in general.
